sentences.en: From The New York Times, this is The Interview.
sentences.zh: 来自纽约时报，这里是《访谈》。

sentences.en: I'm Lulu Garcia Navarro.
sentences.zh: 我是露露·加西亚-纳瓦罗。

sentences.en: There is one thing that's certain about this year's election.
sentences.zh: 今年大选有一件事是确定的。

sentences.en: Whatever the result, it will be the end of an era, opening the door to a new generation of political leaders.
sentences.zh: 无论结果如何，这将是一个时代的结束，为新一代政治领袖打开大门。

sentences.en: And for Democrats, there are few politicians buzzier than Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer.
sentences.zh: 对于民主党人来说，密歇根州长格雷琴·惠特默是风头最劲的政治人物之一。

sentences.en: After serving in the Michigan State Legislature,
sentences.zh: 在密歇根州议会任职后，

sentences.en: Whitmer was elected to the governorship in 2018.
sentences.zh: 惠特默于2018年当选州长。

sentences.en: And when COVID hit, she became a national lightning rod for some of the restrictions she put in place, taking hits from Trump,
sentences.zh: 当新冠疫情来袭时，她因实施的一些限制措施而成为全国争论的焦点，并遭到特朗普的抨击，

sentences.en: whose rhetoric she blames for inspiring an assassination attempt against her.
sentences.zh: 她指责特朗普的言论煽动了针对她的暗杀未遂事件。

sentences.en: But it was what Whitmer achieved in 2022 that really cemented her as a political force.
sentences.zh: 但正是惠特默在2022年取得的成就，真正巩固了她作为政治力量的地位。

sentences.en: That year, she was reelected on the back of a reproductive rights ballot referendum.
sentences.zh: 那一年，她凭借堕胎权投票公投成功连任。

sentences.en: She also achieved something that hadn't happened in nearly 40 years in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 她还实现了一件密歇根州近40年来未曾发生过的事。

sentences.en: With the help of redistricting, she gave Democrats a trifecta, with both the statehouse and the Senate flipping to blue.
sentences.zh: 在选区重划的帮助下，她为民主党赢得了“三连胜”，众议院和参议院都翻蓝了。

sentences.en: In the past few years, Whitmer has leveraged that majority to enact a progressive wishlist of policies, including basic but meaningful gun control legislation,
sentences.zh: 在过去几年里，惠特默利用多数优势颁布了一系列进步主义政策愿望清单，包括基础但意义重大的枪支管制立法，

sentences.en: a new clean energy plan.
sentences.zh: 一项新的清洁能源计划。

sentences.en: And she's also been pushing for educational reforms like universal pre-K and free community college.
sentences.zh: 她还一直在推动教育改革，比如全民学前班和免费社区学院。

sentences.en: Whitmer is term limited, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，惠特默受任期限制。

sentences.en: Her governorship will end in 2026.
sentences.zh: 她的州长任期将于2026年结束。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of speculation about what's next for her.
sentences.zh: 关于她的下一步去向，有很多猜测。

sentences.en: Like many politicians with national ambitions, she's written a new book about her life and vision for the country.
sentences.zh: 像许多有全国雄心的政治家一样，她写了一本关于自己生平和对国家愿景的新书。

sentences.en: It's called True Gretchen.
sentences.zh: 书名叫《真实的格雷琴》。

sentences.en: She's also raising her profile as co-chair of President Biden's re-election campaign.
sentences.zh: 作为拜登总统竞选团队的联合主席，她也在提升自己的知名度。

sentences.en: We talk about Biden's challenges in the second half of our conversation and about whether she can deliver the must-win state of Michigan.
sentences.zh: 我们在访谈的后半部分谈到了拜登面临的挑战，以及她能否为密歇根这个必胜的州拉来选票。

sentences.en: Here's my conversation with Governor Gretchen Whitmer.
sentences.zh: 以下是我与州长格雷琴·惠特默的对话。

sentences.en: Get the elephant out of the room, which is you're releasing this memoir in the middle of the 2024 election cycle.
sentences.zh: 开门见山地说吧，你是在2024年大选周期中间出版这本回忆录的。

sentences.en: So why now?
sentences.zh: 那么为什么是现在？

sentences.en: So it's less of a memoir and more of like a handbook.
sentences.zh: 所以与其说这是一本回忆录，不如说它更像是一本手册。

sentences.en: The question I get whenever I'm traveling, even within Michigan, but certainly outside of Michigan as well, is how do I stay positive?
sentences.zh: 无论我走到哪里，甚至在密歇根州内，当然也在密歇根州外，人们问我的问题都是：我该如何保持积极心态？

sentences.en: And all the ugliness and craziness that I've had to lead the state of Michigan through, how do I stay positive?
sentences.zh: 在引领密歇根州经历的所有丑陋和疯狂中，我该如何保持积极？

sentences.en: Why do I want to keep doing this work?
sentences.zh: 为什么我还想继续做这项工作？

sentences.en: And I thought, you know, this is going to be another heavy year, 2024.
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道的，2024年将是又一个沉重的一年。

sentences.en: Sure is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It's going to feel very dark at times with the political rhetoric and this important election coming up.
sentences.zh: 伴随着政治言论和即将到来的这场重要选举，有时会让人觉得非常黑暗。

sentences.en: And I thought, if I can put some light out into the world right now, maybe you can laugh at my expense.
sentences.zh: 我想，如果我能在此时向世界散发出一些光芒，也许你们可以拿我开开玩笑。

sentences.en: Or maybe there's a little inspiration here that'll help you get through whatever you were navigating.
sentences.zh: 或者这里有一点灵感，能帮你们度过你们正在经历的任何事情。

sentences.en: Were you worried about how it was going to be perceived, though, putting it there at this moment?
sentences.zh: 然而，你有没有担心过它会被如何看待，把它放在这个时刻？

sentences.en: Because you can put light into the dark at any time.
sentences.zh: 因为你随时都可以把光照进黑暗。

sentences.en: But this is, as you mentioned, just a very important election.
sentences.zh: 但正如你所提到的，这是一场非常重要的选举。

sentences.en: And you are a very prominent Democrat.
sentences.zh: 而且你是一位非常杰出的民主党人。

sentences.en: You know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: I can't worry about how everything's going to be perceived.
sentences.zh: 我无法担心每件事会被如何看待。

sentences.en: That's one lesson I certainly have learned in the last six years.
sentences.zh: 这是我在过去六年里肯定学到的一课。

sentences.en: No matter what I do or say, people are going to have their own take on it.
sentences.zh: 无论我做什么或说什么，人们都会有他们自己的看法。

sentences.en: So you got to do what, you know, the right thing to do is.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须做你认为正确的事。

sentences.en: This book did help me understand you as a person.
sentences.zh: 这本书确实帮我更好地理解了你这个人。

sentences.en: It is a book that talks a lot about your own personal story, how you view the world.
sentences.zh: 这是一本讲述你个人故事、你如何看待世界的书。

sentences.en: You write in the book about how you partied in high school and college and that you didn't really become ambitious until you got into law school.
sentences.zh: 你在书中写到你在高中和大学时如何纵情派对，直到进入法学院才真正变得有野心。

sentences.en: You talk about how you actually threw up on your principal who found you passed out in the parking lot from drinking.
sentences.zh: 你谈到你甚至吐在了你的校长身上，因为校长发现你喝得烂醉如泥，昏倒在停车场。

sentences.en: And, first of all, like mortifying.
sentences.zh: 首先，这真是太丢脸了。

sentences.en: But you didn't include this in your book for no reason.
sentences.zh: 但你把这个写进书里并非毫无理由。

sentences.en: So I'm curious, what were you hoping to show?
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，你希望展现什么？

sentences.en: Well, every one of us has our flaws, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们每个人都有缺点，对吧？

sentences.en: That was a period of time when, you know, I was not particularly disciplined and was focused more on having fun.
sentences.zh: 那是一段时期，你知道的，我不是特别纪律严明，更多的是专注于玩乐。

sentences.en: And that's okay, too.
sentences.zh: 那也没关系。

sentences.en: I learned a lot during that period of time.
sentences.zh: 我在那段时间学到了很多。

sentences.en: But it was that real big screw-up that taught me each phase in life.
sentences.zh: 但正是那个巨大的失误教会了我人生中的每一个阶段。

sentences.en: You learn things, you've got opportunities.
sentences.zh: 你学习东西，你拥有机会。

sentences.en: And my mom and I, we had a very tough relationship during that period of time as I would have had with my daughters if they'd been as wild as I was at that age.
sentences.zh: 我和我妈妈在那段时间关系非常紧张，就像如果我的女儿们像我当年那样狂野，我也会和她们那样。

sentences.en: But I also was the moment where I really learned who I was.
sentences.zh: 但这也是我真正认清自己的时刻。

sentences.en: And when I went to law school is when it all started to click for me.
sentences.zh: 当我进入法学院时，一切对我来说都开始豁然开朗。

sentences.en: So I was a little bit more of a late bloomer than my sister was.
sentences.zh: 所以比起我姐姐，我稍微有点大器晚成。

sentences.en: But by the same token, I think these are lessons that help keep me humble.
sentences.zh: 但同样的道理，我认为这些教训帮助我保持谦逊。

sentences.en: And fortunately, when I was a teenager, we didn't all have phones where we could film one another making, you know, not the greatest judgments.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，当我还是个青少年时，我们没有人人都有的手机，可以把彼此做出不是最好判断的行为拍下来。

sentences.en: Yeah, for sure.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: And in fact, you make a point that humor and being able to not take yourself so seriously is part of what you think makes you a powerful politician in a way.
sentences.zh: 事实上，你指出幽默以及不把自己看得太重，是你认为让你在某种程度上成为一个强有力政治家的部分原因。

sentences.en: You actually put a picture of yourself in the book missing a front tooth because you had an accident growing up.
sentences.zh: 你甚至在书中放了一张自己少了一颗门牙的照片，因为你小时候出过事故。

sentences.en: So first of all, it's funny that you married a dentiSt.
sentences.zh: 首先，你嫁给了一个牙医，这很有趣。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: As a woman, though, we're always so attuned to the way we look, how we're perceived.
sentences.zh: 然而，作为女性，我们总是对自己的外表以及别人的看法非常敏感。

sentences.en: I mean, women we know, and specifically in politics, get judged a lot more harshly.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们知道女性，尤其是政界女性，受到的评价要严苛得多。

sentences.en: Do you worry about that?
sentences.zh: 你担心这个吗？

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 我担心。

sentences.en: You know, especially at the beginning of my career as a young woman in going into politics.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，尤其是在我职业生涯的初期，作为一个年轻女性踏入政坛时。

sentences.en: Women, of course, you know, we can't just switch out ties every day.
sentences.zh: 女性，当然，你知道的，我们不能每天只换换领带。

sentences.en: We've got to be mindful of what we wear on top of how we look, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 除了长相之外，我们还得注意自己穿什么，等等。

sentences.en: And so it can get expensive.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能会变得很昂贵。

sentences.en: Most of the things that I wear and buy are actually secondhand.
sentences.zh: 我穿的大多数衣服和买的东西其实都是二手的。

sentences.en: And I rented a dress from Rent the Runway to give my first state of the state speech in.
sentences.zh: 为了发表我的第一场州情咨文演讲，我从Rent the Runway租了一件礼服。

sentences.en: And the predominantly Republican legislature to whom I was addressing at the time, I knew that there were a lot of things that they weren't going to
sentences.zh: 我当时演讲的对象主要是共和党议员，我知道有很多事情他们不会在价值观和对州的愿景上与我达成一致。

sentences.en: share as terms of values and vision for the state.
sentences.zh: 共享价值观和对州的愿景。

sentences.en: And when I laid out the vision, but I wanted to feel confident going in.
sentences.zh: 当我阐述这个愿景时，我希望自己进去时能感到自信。

sentences.en: I wore this, I thought, attractive blue dress.
sentences.zh: 我穿了这件我认为很好看的蓝色裙子。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: The fashion police showed up the next day.
sentences.zh: 时尚警察第二天就出现了。

sentences.en: It was the critique was not about what I said or the important message that I shared.
sentences.zh: 批评的焦点不是我说的话，也不是我分享的重要信息。

sentences.en: It was about what I was wearing.
sentences.zh: 而是我穿了什么。

sentences.en: And they actually interviewed people about how they thought I looked in that dress.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至还采访了人们对我穿那条裙子样子的看法。

sentences.en: And, you know, as the mother of two young women, it was just crushing, not because it hurt my
sentences.zh: 而且，作为一个年轻女性的母亲，这简直是毁灭性的打击，不是因为伤害了我的感情，而是因为我刚刚当选一个1000万人口的州的首席执行官，我们要应对严重的问题，而我正在这里阐述对一个州的愿景。

sentences.en: feelings, but because here I am laying out a vision for a state after just getting elected the chief executive officer of a state of 10 million people where we have serious issues
sentences.zh: 我们要应对严重的问题。

sentences.en: to tackle.
sentences.zh: 而这正是我当时在谈论的。

sentences.en: And that's what I was talking about.
sentences.zh: 但焦点却是我穿了什么。

sentences.en: And the focus was what I was on, what I was wearing.
sentences.zh: 我想我们面对的这种审视比男性要多得多。

sentences.en: And I think that we deal with a lot more of that than men ever do.
sentences.zh: 我很注意这一点，因为我希望人们关注我说的话，而不是其他任何事情。

sentences.en: And I am mindful of it because I want people to focus on what I'm saying, not not anything else.
sentences.zh: 当你说是注意这一点时，你是把你的性别放在首位，还是假装它不存在？

sentences.en: When you say you're mindful of it, do you forefront your gender or do you pretend that it's not there?
sentences.zh: 我不会谈论它。

sentences.en: I'm not going to talk about it.
sentences.zh: 我只是一个穿着西装的人，我的性别并不重要。

sentences.en: I'm a person in a suit and and my gender doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 或者你觉得作为一个女性政治家，你带来了不同的东西？

sentences.en: Or do you feel that there is a different thing that as a female politician you bring to the table?
sentences.zh: 老实说，露露，我摇摆不定。

sentences.en: I go back and forth, to be honest, Lulu.
sentences.zh: 我认为有些时刻你可能会把某种情况当作一个学习机会去教育别人。

sentences.en: I think that there are moments where you might take a situation as a learning opportunity to educate someone.
sentences.zh: 有些时候，当你谈论本质上与性别相关的事情时，

sentences.en: There are moments where when you're talking about something that is inherently gender based,
sentences.zh: 比如生殖权利，我会谈论我作为女性、作为性侵幸存者的经历。

sentences.en: reproductive rights, for instance, talk about my experience as a woman, as a sexual assault survivor.
sentences.zh: 有些时候我选择无视噪音，咬牙坚持过去。

sentences.en: There are moments where I ignore the noise and just muster through.
sentences.zh: 所以这，我认为是一种权衡，权衡听起来可能太像是有预谋了。

sentences.en: So it's, I think, a calculation, a calculation maybe sounds too, you know, planning.
sentences.zh: 这是女性必须随时做出的评估。

sentences.en: It's a assessment that women have to make at all times.
sentences.zh: 我在参议院时，有个同事走过来对我说了一些完全越界且非常过分的话。

sentences.en: Colleague, when I was in the Senate, came up to me and said something totally out of bounds and very over the line.
sentences.zh: 我记得我当时坐在那里想，我必须弄清楚该如何回应。

sentences.en: And I remember sitting there thinking, I've got to figure out how to respond to this.
sentences.zh: 我能教育他为什么他刚才说的话完全不合适吗？

sentences.en: Can I educate him why what he just said is totally inappropriate?
sentences.zh: 我是该无视它？

sentences.en: Do I ignore it?
sentences.zh: 还是笑一笑把它刷过去，告诉他，你知道的，他很愚蠢？

sentences.en: Do I laugh and brush it off and tell him, you know, that he's foolish?
sentences.zh: 我是该非常严肃地对待它？

sentences.en: Do I take it on in a very serious way?
sentences.zh: 有时候去琢磨该如何应对别人的糟糕行为真的很让人精疲力竭。

sentences.en: And it's sometimes exhausting to figure out how do I have to respond to someone else's bad behavior?
sentences.zh: 但我很注意这一点，因为我想到了那些后来者或我自己的女儿们。

sentences.en: But I am mindful because I think about the women who come after me or my own daughters.
sentences.zh: 那你决定怎么做？

sentences.en: And what did you decide?
sentences.zh: 嗯，在那次事件中，我用了一些很粗俗的语言回应了他，让他知道了自己的位置，从那以后他就再也没烦过我。

sentences.en: Well, in that one, I responded with some very colorful language and put him in his place and he never bothered me again.
sentences.zh: 我想聊聊你作为政治领袖的一面，因为你被视为民主党新星的原因之一，就是你在一个摇摆州是一位受欢迎的州长。

sentences.en: I want to talk a little bit about you as a political leader, because one of the reasons
sentences.zh: 在2022年，你为民主党赢得了“三连胜”。

sentences.en: you are viewed as this rising star for Democrats is that you are a popular governor in a battleground state.
sentences.zh: 你赢了众议院，赢了参议院，还赢得了州长职位。

sentences.en: In 2022, you got a trifecta for the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 我想我的问题是，当发生这种事时，特别是在一个分歧如此严重的州，你有两种选择。

sentences.en: You won the House, you won the Senate, and you won the governorship.
sentences.zh: 你可以决定做一些红州和紫州州长做过的事，也就是宣布，我要做一个温和派。

sentences.en: I guess my question is, there's two ways that you can move when something like that happens, especially in a state that is so closely divided.
sentences.zh: 我要采取更渐进的步伐。

sentences.en: You can decide to do what some governors in red states and purple states have done, which is to say, I'm going to be a centriSt.
sentences.zh: 或者你可以推行非常具有党派色彩的议程，对吧？

sentences.en: I'm going to move more incrementally.
sentences.zh: 你走了第二条路。

sentences.en: Or you can enact what is a very partisan agenda, right?
sentences.zh: 那里的权衡是什么？

sentences.en: You took that second route.
sentences.zh: 为什么你决定，我一定要大干一场？

sentences.en: What was the calculation there?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们是带着一个议程竞选的，人们因为那个议程选举了我们。

sentences.en: Why did you decide, I'm going to really try and run with the ball?
sentences.zh: 所以我的哲学是，如果人们选举你去做某事，那就去做。

sentences.en: Well, we ran on an agenda and people elected us on that agenda.
sentences.zh: 不要浪费时间。

sentences.en: And so my philosophy is, if people have elected you to do something, do it.
sentences.zh: 不要找借口。

sentences.en: Don't waste time.
sentences.zh: 兑现承诺。

sentences.en: Don't make excuses.
sentences.zh: 我很感激我得到了第二个任期。

sentences.en: Deliver.
sentences.zh: 在2022年竞选连任时，很多人都在写我的政治讣告。

sentences.en: And I'm grateful that I've got this second term.
sentences.zh: 我最终以近11个百分点的优势获胜。

sentences.en: A lot of folks are writing my political obituary going into the reelect in 2022.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这让我感到非常自信，人们期望我按照我竞选时的议题去领导。

sentences.en: I ended up winning by almost 11 points.
sentences.zh: 不过，我也想确保认识到，我认为在密歇根州，你无法赢得选举

sentences.en: And that, for me, made me feel very confident that people expected me to lead on the issues on which I was running.
I also, though, want to make sure to recognize, I think you can't win an election in Michigan
sentences.zh: （此句不完整或多余）

sentences.en: by double digits if you're not also drawing over people who are not traditional Democrats.
sentences.zh: 如果不把那些非传统民主党人的选民也争取过来的话，这个差距就会拉大到两位数。

sentences.en: And I'm proud of that.
sentences.zh: 对此我很骄傲。

sentences.en: One of the stories in the book I tell is about my friend Randy Richardville, the Republican leader.
sentences.zh: 我在书里讲的故事之一，是关于我的朋友、共和党领袖兰迪·理查德维尔的。

sentences.en: And we had a lot of knockdown drag outs.
sentences.zh: 我们以前经常吵得不可开交。

sentences.en: When I was the Democratic leader in the Senate, he was the Republican leader.
sentences.zh: 当我是参议院的民主党领袖时，他是共和党领袖。

sentences.en: He was in the majority.
sentences.zh: 当时他在多数党。

sentences.en: We did battle.
sentences.zh: 我们针锋相对。

sentences.en: We'd often, though, also end the day going and grabbing a beer together, because I think
sentences.zh: 不过，我们通常也会在一天结束时去一起喝杯啤酒，因为我认为

sentences.en: that it's important to not take things personally, but to stay focused on doing the job and also
sentences.zh: 保持不记仇、专注于工作是很重要的，同时

sentences.en: trying to continue to build relationships with diverse sets of interests and people.
sentences.zh: 还要努力继续与有着不同利益和背景的人建立联系。

sentences.en: That's what our system is supposed to be about.
sentences.zh: 这本该是我们体制的意义所在。

sentences.en: It's supposed to be about that.
sentences.zh: 它本来就该是这样的。

sentences.en: But, you know, one of the things that I know other Democrats have pointed to is that the
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，其他民主党人指出的一点是

sentences.en: Republican Party under Donald Trump has gone in a particular direction that makes that they feel very, very difficult.
sentences.zh: 在唐纳德·特朗普领导下的共和党走向了一个特定的方向，让他们觉得这非常非常困难。

sentences.en: So that sounds great to sit and have a beer with your political adversary.
sentences.zh: 所以坐下来和你的政治对手喝杯啤酒听起来很棒。

sentences.en: But at the same time, there are huge ideological chasms at the moment.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，目前存在着巨大的意识形态鸿沟。

sentences.en: There's no question.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: I mean, it's challenging.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这很有挑战性。

sentences.en: I don't ever want to imply that it's easy.
sentences.zh: 我可从没想过暗示这很容易。

sentences.en: It takes work.
sentences.zh: 这需要付出努力。

sentences.en: It takes thick skin and a short memory.
sentences.zh: 需要厚脸皮和健忘症。

sentences.en: And that's a good thing in politics.
sentences.zh: 在政治上，这是件好事。

sentences.en: That's for sure.
sentences.zh: 那是肯定的。

sentences.en: During the pandemic, when things were really at their hottest, when the former president singled me out and called me that woman from Michigan, and I was getting a lot of threats
sentences.zh: 在疫情期间，当局势最白热化的时候，当时任总统把我挑出来，叫我“那个来自密歇根的女人”时，我当时收到了很多威胁

sentences.en: at the time, my Republican-led legislature, who'd worked with me pretty well up until that moment, really turned on me.
sentences.zh: 我那个由共和党领导的立法机构，在此之前一直跟我合作得挺好，但当时真的调转枪头对付我了。

sentences.en: That was the moment when everything kind of changed.
sentences.zh: 那是所有事情都发生某种转变的时刻。

sentences.en: I share a picture in the book from the window that I took on my phone when they had a demonstration.
sentences.zh: 我在书里分享了一张照片，那是我用手机从窗户拍的，当时他们正在举行游行。

sentences.en: People showed up in their cars and shut down the capital city.
sentences.zh: 人们开着车出现，把首府堵得水泄不通。

sentences.en: And they were holding up signs calling me, you know, a Nazi.
sentences.zh: 他们举着标牌，你知道的，骂我是纳粹。

sentences.en: We saw Confederate flags, saw a Barbie that was dressed like me and hanging from a noose.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了邦联旗，看到了一个打扮成我模样的芭比娃娃被吊在绞索上。

sentences.en: And it was shocking.
sentences.zh: 这太令人震惊了。

sentences.en: I also had a Republican leader who took to calling me names and shared a stage with a lot of the, some of the folks that ultimately were tried for the plot to kidnap and kill me.
sentences.zh: 我还有一个共和党领袖，开始对恶语相向，并且和许多最终因密谋绑架和谋杀我而受审的人同台亮相。

sentences.en: And yet I had to keep negotiating with that guy because I had to get a budget done.
sentences.zh: 然而，我不得不继续和那个家伙谈判，因为我必须把预算案通过。

sentences.en: And so I think that that short memory and thick skin is really important if we're going to try to bridge these gaps, because I got a job to do at the end of the day.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得，如果我们想弥合这些分歧，这种“健忘”和“厚脸皮”真的很重要，因为到头来我还有工作要做。

sentences.en: Let's talk about that era, because it was the period when you became a national figure.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈那个时期吧，因为那是你成为全国知名人物的阶段。

sentences.en: Very early on, you and then-President Trump were at odds, to put it mildly.
sentences.zh: 很早的时候，你和当时的总统特朗普就意见不合，委婉地说。

sentences.en: And you became a symbol of what Republicans saw as draconian pandemic restrictions.
sentences.zh: 而你成了共和党人眼中严苛的防疫限制措施的象征。

sentences.en: You faced protests, death threats.
sentences.zh: 你面临着抗议和死亡威胁。

sentences.en: You write that you were shocked at how virulent the reaction was.
sentences.zh: 你在书中写到，对于反应会如此激烈，你感到震惊。

sentences.en: Looking back, why do you think people reacted the way they did so quickly?
sentences.zh: 回过头来看，你认为为什么人们会这么快就做出这样的反应？

sentences.en: One of the things that I did during the pandemic was talk to my colleagues a lot, especially my Midwestern group of governors, bipartisan group, Ohio, Indiana, Illinois, Wisconsin,
sentences.zh: 我在疫情期间做的一件事就是经常和我的同僚交流，尤其是我的中西部州长同行们，这是一个两党的小组，包括俄亥俄州、印第安纳州、伊利诺伊州、威斯康星州、

sentences.en: Minnesota, and even Kentucky.
sentences.zh: 明尼苏达州，甚至还有肯塔基州。

sentences.en: And it was really helpful for perspective.
sentences.zh: 这对于转换视角真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: Every one of us was dealing with some level of that animosity.
sentences.zh: 我们每个人都在应对某种程度的这种敌意。

sentences.en: In swing states, it was even more heightened because of the political dynamic.
sentences.zh: 在摇摆州，由于政治动态，这种敌意更加严重。

sentences.en: And I think some intentional efforts to really gin it up.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，其中有一些是蓄意煽动起来的。

sentences.en: But every one of us was dealing with it.
sentences.zh: 但我们每个人都在应对它。

sentences.en: When I chatted with Mike DeWine, who is in a Republican-controlled state of Ohio, and he's dealing with threats or dealing with anger from his legislature,
sentences.zh: 当我与迈克·德温交谈时，他身处由共和党控制的俄亥俄州，他也正在应对来自立法机构的威胁或愤怒，

sentences.en: trying to scale back his executive powers.
sentences.zh: 他们试图削减他的行政权力。

sentences.en: That was really good for perspective for me.
sentences.zh: 这让我获得了很好的视角。

sentences.en: I will say, though, that it was uniquely worse in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 不过，我要说的是，密歇根的情况明显更糟糕。

sentences.en: One of my colleagues on our group call said,
sentences.zh: 我们在开小组电话会议时，我的一个同行说，

sentences.en: you know, Gretchen, you're doing a lot of the same things the rest of us are, but why do you take so much more crap for it?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，格蕾琴，你做的事和我们其他人没两样，但为什么你因此挨了更多的骂？

sentences.en: And he said, as soon as that last word landed, he said, wait, don't answer that question.
sentences.zh: 他说，最后一个字刚落音，他就说，等等，别回答那个问题。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: You're the one woman that's doing it of this group of governors.
sentences.zh: 在这群州长里，你就是那个女的。

sentences.en: You think it was sexism?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这是性别歧视吗？

sentences.en: Well, that was his theory, and I'm not going to combat that.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那是他的理论，我不会去反驳。

sentences.en: I do think that that was maybe what made our situation in Michigan stand out.
sentences.zh: 我的确认为，那或许正是让我们在密歇根的处境显得与众不同的原因。

sentences.en: So, things went off the rails in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 所以，密歇根的事情彻底失控了。

sentences.en: In October 2020, 14 men ended up being arrested for plotting to kidnap you and overthrow the Michigan government.
sentences.zh: 2020年10月，有14名男子因密谋绑架你并推翻密歇根州政府而被捕。

sentences.en: You write in the book that this was referred to in the press as a kidnapping plot, but you say that's not accurate.
sentences.zh: 你在书中写到，媒体将此事称为绑架阴谋，但你说这并不准确。

sentences.en: Can you tell me why not?
sentences.zh: 能告诉我为什么不准确吗？

sentences.en: What do you see it as?
sentences.zh: 你认为这到底是什么？

sentences.en: I'll tell you in context of another situation that was covered as a assassination attempt.
sentences.zh: 我用另一个被报道为暗杀未遂的情况来作类比告诉你。

sentences.en: Not long ago, there was a single person that showed up on Justice Kavanaugh's lawn, and it's been covered as an assassination attempt.
sentences.zh: 不久前，曾有一个人出现在卡瓦诺大法官的草坪上，这被报道为暗杀未遂。

sentences.en: It was one person.
sentences.zh: 那只有一个人。

sentences.en: He was apprehended well before any threat really became real to Justice Kavanaugh, and I'm grateful for that.
sentences.zh: 早在威胁对卡瓦诺大法官真正成为现实之前，他就被捕了，对此我很感激。

sentences.en: I recognize a threat against anyone, no matter who they are, what their political views is,
sentences.zh: 我承认，针对任何人的威胁，无论他们是谁，无论他们的政治观点是什么，

sentences.en: undermines our system of democracy, and I think it's really important that we all call it out when it happens.
sentences.zh: 都在破坏我们的民主制度，我认为发生这种事时我们所有人都将其大声指出来非常重要。

sentences.en: The way that was covered versus how 12 to 14 people who were plotting over the series of months, who were doing exercises, they had what they called a kill house,
sentences.zh: 当时的报道方式，与那12到14个人在几个月的时间里进行密谋、进行演练、他们建了所谓的杀戮屋、

sentences.en: running through scenarios about how to kidnap me and kill me.
sentences.zh: 反复演练如何绑架我和谋杀我的各种方案相比。

sentences.en: And let's be clear, they weren't going to keep me for ransom.
sentences.zh: 我们要搞清楚，他们不是要把我留着勒索赎金。

sentences.en: Their intention was to, you know, like a terrorist organization, have a sham trial and then execute me.
sentences.zh: 他们的意图是，像恐怖组织一样，进行一次虚假的审判然后处决我。

sentences.en: It was very clear in a lot of their communications that was the plan, and it was over the series of months.
sentences.zh: 在他们的大量通讯中，这个计划非常明确，而且持续了数月之久。

sentences.en: They staked out a vacation property that my husband and I have on more than one occasion.
sentences.zh: 我和丈夫在不止一个地方拥有度假物业，他们对那里进行了踩点。

sentences.en: They had plots to blow up bridges and kill police officers as well, to even burn down the Capitol, locking the legislature inside.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至还有炸毁桥梁、杀害警察的计划，甚至还密谋把国会大厦烧掉，把议员锁在里面。

sentences.en: All of that has been labeled a kidnapping plot, and it does feel like it is to discount the seriousness.
sentences.zh: 所有这一切都被贴上了绑架阴谋的标签，这感觉就像是在淡化其严重性。

sentences.en: It was, over such a longer period of time, so many more people involved, so many weapons involved, and yet the discrepancy of how that was covered
sentences.zh: 这起阴谋持续的时间更长、涉及的人数更多、涉及的武器也更多，然而，与对卡瓦诺大法官草坪上那个人的报道相比，

sentences.en: versus how this one person on Justice Kavanaugh's lawn was covered was really shocking when you think about it.
sentences.zh: 这种报道上的差异细想起来真是令人震惊。

sentences.en: You write in the book that you want to meet with one of the plotters who pleaded guilty who is in prison now.
sentences.zh: 你在书中写到，你想见见其中一位认罪的、目前正在服刑的同谋。

sentences.en: What do you want to know?
sentences.zh: 你想知道什么？

sentences.en: I'd like to understand what drove this group of people to take this extreme position and to try to undergo this exercise to try to kidnap me and kill me.
sentences.zh: 我想了解是什么驱使这群人采取这种极端的立场，并试图进行这种演练来绑架我并杀死我。

sentences.en: I want to understand it.
sentences.zh: 我想理解这一点。

sentences.en: What is happening?
sentences.zh: 到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: You think there's something to understand?
sentences.zh: 你认为有什么可理解的吗？

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许有吧。

sentences.en: Maybe there's not.
sentences.zh: 也许没有。

sentences.en: But I'd like to see.
sentences.zh: 但我很想看看。

sentences.en: I'd like to know, is it because there wasn't for that person economic opportunity?
sentences.zh: 我想知道，是不是因为这个人没有经济机会？

sentences.en: Was it because they got laid off during the pandemic and they were really worried about how they were going to make their house payment?
sentences.zh: 是不是因为他们在疫情期间被解雇了，然后非常担心房贷该怎么付？

sentences.en: What was it that set them off?
sentences.zh: 究竟是什么让他们爆发了？

sentences.en: It can't just be the fact that we wanted people to wear a mask because they showed up in masks to be not identified.
sentences.zh: 总不能仅仅是因为我们希望人们戴口罩吧，因为他们出现时也戴着口罩以防被认出。

sentences.en: So it wasn't the act of wearing a mask, but what was it?
sentences.zh: 所以戴口罩本身不是原因，那到底是什么？

sentences.en: What was happening that, is there a lesson to learn from this?
sentences.zh: 到底发生了什么，从中有什么教训可吸取吗？

sentences.en: That's what I always want to know.
sentences.zh: 这就是我一直想知道的。

sentences.en: Do you forgive the plotters?
sentences.zh: 你原谅这些同谋了吗？

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 我原谅了。

sentences.en: And eight of them are doing a hard time now.
sentences.zh: 其中八个人现在正在里面吃苦头。

sentences.en: So I think that's important to point out.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这一点很重要。

sentences.en: Some were acquitted.
sentences.zh: 有些人被无罪释放了。

sentences.en: And you write in the book that you think that that was unfair.
sentences.zh: 你在书中写到，你认为这不公平。

sentences.en: I do think that it was, you know, very sad to see such a disparate treatment of people that were a part of the same undertaking.
sentences.zh: 我的确觉得，看到对参与同一桩罪行的人有如此截然不同的对待，是非常令人痛心的。

sentences.en: And I think it does us all a disfavor if there's not accountability.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，如果不进行问责，对我们所有人都是不利的。

sentences.en: But for the ones who took accountability and who shared their remorse and participated with the prosecution,
sentences.zh: 但对于那些承担了责任、表达了悔意并配合检方工作的人，

sentences.en: I did ask the judge to take that into account and to recognize that that is a positive outcome.
sentences.zh: 我确实要求法官将这一点考虑在内，并认识到这是一个积极的结果。

sentences.en: And hopefully that that was reflected in the sentencing.
sentences.zh: 希望这一点能在量刑中得到体现。

sentences.en: Separate from what happened to you during this period of the pandemic, I do want to ask you about some of the lessons that you may have learned.
sentences.zh: 撇开你在疫情期间遭遇的事情不谈，我还想问问你可能吸取的一些教训。

sentences.en: Michigan's stay-at-home order did last longer than other states.
sentences.zh: 密歇根州的居家令确实比其他州持续的时间更长。

sentences.en: You closed all the schools in March 2020, and you didn't urge them to be reopened until a year later.
sentences.zh: 你在2020年3月关闭了所有学校，直到一年后才敦促它们重新开放。

sentences.en: Do you think now that we sort of have the fullness of hindsight,
sentences.zh: 你现在认为，当我们拥有了事后的全盘认知时，

sentences.en: schools should have reopened earlier because we know now how profoundly it impacted kids to be out of the classroom?
sentences.zh: 学校应该更早重新开放吗？因为我们现在知道不能去学校上课对孩子们产生了多么深远的影响。

sentences.en: I have said many times that if I could go back in time with the knowledge we've accumulated now, there certainly are things that I would have done differently.
sentences.zh: 我曾多次说过，如果我能带着我们现在积累的知识回到过去，肯定有些事情我会做出不同的处理。

sentences.en: I also want to remind everyone that during that period of time,
sentences.zh: 我也想提醒大家，在那段时间里，

sentences.en: Michigan was so hot compared to the rest of the country.
sentences.zh: 与全国其他地方相比，密歇根的疫情形势非常严峻。

sentences.en: It was New York, Detroit, it was Chicago, and it was New Orleans that were having massive impact from COVID.
sentences.zh: 当时是纽约、底特律、芝加哥和新奥尔良受到了新冠病毒的巨大冲击。

sentences.en: Our hospitals were at real brink.
sentences.zh: 我们的医院已经到了真正崩溃的边缘。

sentences.en: Of course, you were dealing with the situation, and no one really knew how to deal with this.
sentences.zh: 当然，你当时在处理这种局面，而且没有人真正知道该如何应对。

sentences.en: It's less about what you were facing, but more specifically about the impacts of schools.
sentences.zh: 这其实不在于你当时面临的情况，而更具体地在于对学校的影响。

sentences.en: You're seeing it in Michigan, chronic absenteeism, students performing below pre-pandemic levels in reading and math.
sentences.zh: 你在密歇根看到了这一点，慢性的旷课率，学生的阅读和数学表现低于疫情前的水平。

sentences.en: So just applying that as the current governor, what do you see maybe the lessons are of that period, particularly when it comes to kids in schools?
sentences.zh: 因此，仅以此作为现任州长的视角，你认为这段时期的教训可能是什么，特别是涉及到学校里的孩子们时？

sentences.en: I think we have to remember that we were looking at lessons from the Spanish flu and recognizing that we hadn't dealt with a global pandemic in 100 years,
sentences.zh: 我认为我们必须记住，当时我们正在借鉴西班牙大流感时期的教训，并认识到我们已经有一百年没有应对过全球大流行了，

sentences.en: that that particular virus absolutely was devastating to younger people.
sentences.zh: 那个特定的病毒对年轻人来说绝对是毁灭性的。

sentences.en: And as a person taking in as much information as I could from our epidemiologists and our public health experts,
sentences.zh: 作为一个尽可能从我们的流行病学家和公共卫生专家那里吸收信息的个人，

sentences.en: the thought that we might have a lot of school-age kids that were going to die from this virus, I think, was really what motivated our actions and the actions of lots of governors
sentences.zh: 一想到我们可能会有许多学龄儿童死于这种病毒，我认为这才是真正促使我们以及许多州长采取行动的原因，

sentences.en: when we stopped kids going to school.
sentences.zh: 当时我们叫停了孩子们去上学。

sentences.en: It has carried a long, hard price tag with it.
sentences.zh: 这带来了长期而沉重的代价。

sentences.en: We've made massive investments in early childhood and in free breakfast and lunch for all 1.4 million Michigan kids and literacy coaches.
sentences.zh: 我们在幼儿教育、为所有140万密歇根儿童提供免费早餐和午餐以及读写教练方面作出了巨大投资。

sentences.en: And so we're working to help get our kids back on track.
sentences.zh: 所以我们正在努力帮助我们的孩子回到正轨。

sentences.en: But absolutely, if I could go back in time with the knowledge we have now and knowing this virus didn't disproportionately kill children, would I have done some things differently?
sentences.zh: 但绝对地，如果我能带着现在的知识回到过去，并且知道这种病毒并没有不成比例地夺走儿童的生命，我会做些不同的事情吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Staying in Michigan, one of the more recent issues, it's fair to say that you struggled with, is a conflict in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 留在密歇根的话，最近令你感到棘手的问题之一，可以说加沙冲突。

sentences.en: Michigan has the second largest population of Arab Americans in the country.
sentences.zh: 密歇根拥有全美第二大阿拉伯裔美国人人口。

sentences.en: There was a huge movement to vote uncommitted to protest the Biden administration's handling of the conflict.
sentences.zh: 当时有一场巨大的“不表态”投票运动，以抗议拜登政府对这场冲突的处理。

sentences.en: And in some Arab American communities, up to three quarters of Democrats cast their votes as uncommitted.
sentences.zh: 在一些阿拉伯裔美国人社区，高达四分之三的民主党人将选票投给了“不表态”。

sentences.en: Do you worry that the protest vote will translate into meaningful erosion of Biden's support?
sentences.zh: 你是否担心这场抗议投票会转化为对拜登支持率的实质性侵蚀？

sentences.en: I think one of the really important lessons right now is everyone's hurting.
sentences.zh: 我认为现在一个非常重要的教训是，每个人都在受苦。

sentences.en: The only universal truth here in the States is that everyone's hurting.
sentences.zh: 美国目前唯一的普遍真理就是每个人都在受苦。

sentences.en: We're watching what's happening, the loss of life.
sentences.zh: 我们正在目睹正在发生的事情，生命的消逝。

sentences.en: It's profound.
sentences.zh: 这是深重的。

sentences.en: The hostages that are still, you know, in captivity, the remains of hostages who've not survived.
sentences.zh: 那些仍然处于囚禁中的人质，以及未能幸存的人质的遗体。

sentences.en: So I do think that it was important for people who disagree with the policy to be able to make an outward statement of that through that vote.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实认为，对于那些不同意该政策的人来说，能够通过那张选票公开表态是很重要的。

sentences.en: I also think it's important to recognize we've got a high-stakes election coming up.
sentences.zh: 我也认为认识到我们即将迎来一场高风险的选举非常重要。

sentences.en: We know that this is a very stark choice in front of us, and there are going to be generational impacts from the outcome of this election.
sentences.zh: 我们知道摆在我们面前的是一个非常鲜明的选择，这场选举的结果将对子孙后代产生影响。

sentences.en: And so I'm doing everything I can to make sure that Michiganders in all of these communities feel seen, heard, respected, and reflected in the policies of President Biden.
sentences.zh: 因此，我正在尽我所能，确保所有这些社区的密歇根人在拜登总统的政策中都能感受到自己被看见、被倾听、被尊重，并得到体现。

sentences.en: I mean, what does that look like?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这具体体现在哪里？

sentences.en: Because recent polling has shown that among Muslim and Arab American voters,
sentences.zh: 因为最近的民意调查显示，在穆斯林和阿拉伯裔美国选民中，

sentences.en: Trump is leading Biden by 32 points.
sentences.zh: 特朗普领先拜登32个百分点。

sentences.en: That's a huge defection from 2020.
sentences.zh: 与2020年相比，这是一个巨大的流失。

sentences.en: So how are you addressing that?
sentences.zh: 所以你打算如何解决这个问题？

sentences.en: What we have seen, at least in so many of the conversations that I've had on the ground in
sentences.zh: 我们在密歇根州实地交流时，

sentences.en: Michigan, is this is a community that takes umbrage with the, to put it lightly, with the president's policies.
sentences.zh: 至少在许多对话中，我们看到的是：这个社区对总统的政策（委婉地说）心存不满。

sentences.en: That being said, I hear routinely that they also recognize that a vote for Donald Trump is a vote for someone who pushed a Muslim ban,
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，我经常听到他们也承认，投票给唐纳德·特朗普就是投票给一个曾推动穆斯林禁令的人，

sentences.en: who talks about countries with people of color and incredibly harsh and cruel terMs.
sentences.zh: 一个用极其刺耳和残酷的言辞谈论有色人种国家的人。

sentences.en: I think that making sure that people come out and vote is going to be the important focus of our work going into the fall election.
sentences.zh: 我认为，确保人们出来投票将是我们迎接秋季大选的重要工作重心。

sentences.en: And I don't take any vote for granted, and I don't think that the Biden administration does either.
sentences.zh: 我不会把任何选票视为理所当然，我想拜登政府也是如此。

sentences.en: Last question about Gaza, which is a bit of a personal one.
sentences.zh: 关于加沙的最后一个问题，这有点私人。

sentences.en: We've seen a lot of college activism.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了很多高校维权活动。

sentences.en: You have two college-age daughters.
sentences.zh: 你有两个上大学年龄的女儿。

sentences.en: One just graduated from Michigan, and one is still a student there.
sentences.zh: 一个刚从密歇根毕业，另一个还在那里上学。

sentences.en: What have they been telling you about what's going on in campus?
sentences.zh: 她们一直在跟你说校园里发生了什么吗？

sentences.en: Well, I'm glad that I've got a 22-year-old and a 20-year-old who are very confident and invested and vocal.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我很高兴我有两个22岁和20岁的女儿，她们非常自信、投入而且敢于发声。

sentences.en: And I learn as much from my kids as I do anybody.
sentences.zh: 我从孩子们身上学到的东西不比从任何人身上学到的少。

sentences.en: And I'm grateful.
sentences.zh: 对此我很感激。

sentences.en: You know, my daughter, my oldest, called me early on, probably late last fall, and she was really upset about the deaths in Gaza and the escalating loss of innocent lives,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我大女儿很早就给我打过电话，大概是去年深秋的时候，她对加沙的死亡人数以及无辜生命不断消逝感到非常难过，

sentences.en: jarred by what happened October 7th without question and then the ongoing loss.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，10月7日发生的事情让她大受震撼，随之而来的则是源源不断的伤亡。

sentences.en: I've asked her questions.
sentences.zh: 我问过她一些问题。

sentences.en: You know, she's got a wonderful, diverse group of friends.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，她有一群精彩且多元的朋友。

sentences.en: This generation sees, I think, the humanitarian need and is very motivated to call on our leaders to address the crisis that is playing out every single day.
sentences.zh: 我认为这一代人看到了人道主义的需求，并且非常有动力呼吁我们的领导人去解决每天都在上演的危机。

sentences.en: And so I am very appreciative of their advocacy and activity, and I think it's emblematic of what we're seeing across our younger generation.
sentences.zh: 因此，我非常赞赏她们的倡导和行动，我认为这是我们年轻一代现状的象征。

sentences.en: So you think the protests on campuses were a legitimate expression of that?
sentences.zh: 所以你认为校园抗议活动是对这种情绪的合理表达？

sentences.en: Some of them were.
sentences.zh: 其中一些是的。

sentences.en: Some of them crossed the line.
sentences.zh: 有些越界了。

sentences.en: You know, it's funny.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这很有趣。

sentences.en: As we've been talking, it strikes me that we've been talking about issues in Michigan, but they're all so resonant to the national stage, right?
sentences.zh: 在我们交谈的过程中，我突然意识到，我们一直在谈论密歇根州的问题，但它们在全国舞台上都引起了强烈的共鸣，对吧？

sentences.en: And your state is such a microcosm of what is happening in different parts of this country.
sentences.zh: 而且你们州正是这个国家不同地区现状的一个缩影。

sentences.en: And, you know, you are one of the co-chairs of the Biden re-election campaign.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，你是拜登连任竞选团队的联合主席之一。

sentences.en: As we're speaking today, you just came from the White House.
sentences.zh: 就在我们今天谈话的时候，你刚从白宫过来。

sentences.en: And obviously, the president's age has been an issue for voters.
sentences.zh: 很明显，总统的年龄一直是选民关心的问题。

sentences.en: And there's been a lot of questions about his mental fitness.
sentences.zh: 关于他的精神状态也有很多质疑。

sentences.en: He's 81 years old.
sentences.zh: 他81岁了。

sentences.en: Pretending that this isn't an issue hasn't really been working for Democrats.
sentences.zh: 假装这不是个问题，对民主党人来说并没有什么用。

sentences.en: I mean, it is an issue for voters.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这对选民来说确实是个问题。

sentences.en: Do you see it as a legitimate concern?
sentences.zh: 你认为这是一个合理的担忧吗？

sentences.en: And how should Democrats be talking about it?
sentences.zh: 民主党人应该如何讨论这件事？

sentences.en: Well, one of the things I know is you can't tell people how to feel and you can't tell people to ignore something they are questioning or they're interested in.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我深知的一点是，你无法告诉人们该有什么感受，也无法让人们忽视他们正在质疑或感兴趣的事情。

sentences.en: I think it's important to recognize, yes, the two leading standard bearers for the two big political parties in this country are both, you know, 80-ish, right?
sentences.zh: 我认为认识到这一点很重要：是的，这个国家两个大政党的两位领军人物都，你知道的，80岁左右，对吧？

sentences.en: It's an inescapable fact.
sentences.zh: 这是一个无法回避的事实。

sentences.en: One has got a record of delivering incredibly for the people of our country.
sentences.zh: 其中一位有着为我国人民实实在在办实事的履历。

sentences.en: The CHIPS Act, the IRA, the investment that's happening on shoring supply chains and the investment on bridges and roads all across this country.
sentences.zh: 《芯片法案》、通胀削减法案、回流供应链的投资，以及全国各地桥梁和道路的投资。

sentences.en: President Biden has a record of delivering.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统有着为人民办实事的政绩。

sentences.en: And that's the kind of leadership, I think, that we will see for the next four years if he's re-elected.
sentences.zh: 我认为，如果他再次当选，未来四年我们就会看到这种领导力。

sentences.en: On the contrary, the other 80-ish year old is someone who has not articulated any sort of vision for our country, someone who has been more about dividing us,
sentences.zh: 相反，另一位80岁左右的人没有为我们的国家阐明任何愿景，他更热衷于制造分裂，

sentences.en: someone who, when they don't like someone, will attack them and mobilize their supporters to threaten them, someone who has only talked about grievance and vengeance.
sentences.zh: 一个不喜欢谁就会攻击谁、并动员支持者去威胁谁的人，一个只谈论不满和复仇的人。

sentences.en: And I think people want a leader who is going to make their lives better, who is going to work at it every single day.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们想要一个能让他们的生活变得更好、并为此每天都在努力的领导人。

sentences.en: President Biden has shown that he is that person, and he's the only person that falls into that category in this race for president.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统已经证明了他就是这样的人，在这场总统竞选中，他是唯一符合这一标准的人。

sentences.en: So I'm hearing the message there.
sentences.zh: 我听到这层意思了。

sentences.en: It does make me think, though, something you do write a lot about in the book is the power of messaging, the power of how you articulate a vision.
sentences.zh: 不过这确实让我想起了一点，你在书中经常写到的一点，那就是传达信息的威力，阐明愿景的威力。

sentences.en: It's something that you were very proud of in 2017 and 2018.
sentences.zh: 这是你在2017年和2018年非常引以为豪的一点。

sentences.en: Your slogan was, fix the damn roads.
sentences.zh: 你们当时的口号是：修好这该死的路。

sentences.en: I learned a lot about Michigan roads reading your book.
sentences.zh: 读了你的书，我对密歇根州的道路有了很多了解。

sentences.en: I want to say that I didn't know.
sentences.zh: 我想说我以前并不知道。

sentences.en: You know, but my editor had to Google to find out what Biden's slogan this year was.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，但我编辑不得不去谷歌搜索才知道拜登今年的口号是什么。

sentences.en: And it is, finish the job, which I have to say is not much of a humdinger.
sentences.zh: 结果是，完成工作（finish the job），我不得不说这算不上什么响亮的口号。

sentences.en: I'm curious if you have sharper ideas, because you seem to be good at this.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道你有没有更犀利的想法，因为你在这方面似乎很在行。

sentences.en: And right now, Democrats nationally are really struggling with messaging about where the party stands.
sentences.zh: 而现在，全国的民主党人在传达党派立场的讯息时确实遇到了困难。

sentences.en: When I talk to voters, they really have trouble articulating what Democrats are going to do for them.
sentences.zh: 当我与选民交谈时，他们真的很难说清楚民主党究竟能为他们做些什么。

sentences.en: I think that, I talk to a lot of my colleagues.
sentences.zh: 我想，我和很多同僚交流过。

sentences.en: Governors, I think, know what's going on in their states better than anybody.
sentences.zh: 我认为州长们比任何人都清楚自己州里发生了什么。

sentences.en: And we all get asked, what about the national messaging?
sentences.zh: 我们都会被问到：全国性的讯息策略该是怎样的？

sentences.en: And I think a national message is always a challenge.
sentences.zh: 我认为全国性的讯息传达一直是一个挑战。

sentences.en: Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿特区

sentences.en: is so far away from the average person's life that to conceptualize what a $3 trillion investment in onshore and supply chains means to your everyday life is darn near impossible to discern.
sentences.zh: 离普通人的生活太遥远了，以至于要让人去想象对本土供应链投资3万亿美元对你的日常生活意味着什么，简直难乎其难。

sentences.en: And that's why I've always learned when you show up and ask people, they're going to tell you what they want.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我一直懂得，当你出现并询问人们时，他们会告诉你他们想要什么。

sentences.en: They're going to tell you what they need.
sentences.zh: 他们会告诉你他们需要什么。

sentences.en: And they're going to use the language that they use.
sentences.zh: 而且他们会使用他们自己的语言。

sentences.en: Fix the Damn Roads was not something that we poll tested or focus grouped.
sentences.zh: “修好这该死的路”并不是我们通过民调测试或焦点小组测出来的。

sentences.en: It was just conversation after conversation.
sentences.zh: 它只是源于一次又一次的对话。

sentences.en: What do you need me to do if I'm elected?
sentences.zh: 如果我当选，你们需要我做什么？

sentences.en: Fix the Damn Roads.
sentences.zh: 修好这该死的路。

sentences.en: But Governor Whitmer, it's ironic because President Biden passed an infrastructure bill.
sentences.zh: 但是惠特默州长，这很具有讽刺意味，因为拜登总统通过了一项基础设施法案。

sentences.en: He is fixing the Damn Roads.
sentences.zh: 他确实在修那些该死的路。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And bridges and Internet.
sentences.zh: 还有桥梁和互联网。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But he's not getting credit for it.
sentences.zh: 但他并没有因此受到赞赏。

sentences.en: I mean, why do you think that is?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你认为这是为什么？

sentences.en: For that same reason, right?
sentences.zh: 正是出于同样的原因，对吧？

sentences.en: I think the pandemic's taken a toll.
sentences.zh: 我认为大流行付出了沉重的代价。

sentences.en: People are stressed out.
sentences.zh: 人们压力很大。

sentences.en: They're just trying to pay the grocery bill, get the kids off to school, show up at their job and maybe get a little bit of sleep at night.
sentences.zh: 他们只是在努力支付杂货账单，送孩子去上学，去上班，也许晚上能睡个好觉。

sentences.en: They're not consuming everything.
sentences.zh: 他们没有关注所有的事情。

sentences.en: They can't discern what the CHIPS Act has meant.
sentences.zh: 他们无法辨别《芯片法案》意味着什么。

sentences.en: And so we got to tell that story better.
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要更好地讲述这个故事。

sentences.en: There's no question that that's maybe one of the most important, biggest challenges for us going into this election.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，这可能是我们迎战这次大选最重要、最大的挑战之一。

sentences.en: But in many ways, this is the kind of vibes election.
sentences.zh: 但在许多方面，这是一场所谓的“氛围”选举。

sentences.en: I mean, when you poll people and you ask them, what is the economy doing?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当你对人们进行民意调查并问他们，经济状况如何时？

sentences.en: They think it's in recession.
sentences.zh: 他们认为经济正处于衰退中。

sentences.en: How is the stock market doing?
sentences.zh: 股市表现如何？

sentences.en: They think it's down.
sentences.zh: 他们认为股市在下跌。

sentences.en: There isn't a real understanding of even where the country is at.
sentences.zh: 人们甚至对国家处于什么位置没有真正的了解。

sentences.en: So then how do you reach those people?
sentences.zh: 那么你该如何触及这些人呢？

sentences.en: Well, and an interesting thing, too, is in some of the most recent research, individuals feel like their situation is pretty good, but the rest of the economy is not good.
sentences.zh: 嗯，还有一个有趣的事情，根据最近的一些研究，个人觉得自己的处境挺好，但整体经济却不好。

sentences.en: And that's the absolute inverse of what generally you see.
sentences.zh: 这与你通常看到的现象完全相反。

sentences.en: People feel like, OK, I'm not doing good, but everyone else seems to be getting ahead.
sentences.zh: 人们通常觉得：好吧，我过得不好，但其他人似乎都在向前发展。

sentences.en: It's the inverse.
sentences.zh: 情况完全反过来了。

sentences.en: It's a strange phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 这是一个奇怪的现象。

sentences.en: I don't know how to explain it,
sentences.zh: 我不知道该怎么解释它，

sentences.en: but I do know we've got to make sure that people appreciate all the different things that are happening in their communities because of the work that President Biden has done.
sentences.zh: 但我确实知道，我们必须确保人们赞赏由于拜登总统的工作而在他们社区中发生的所有不同变化。

sentences.en: So last question, Biden is behind in many polls, and certainly it is close in swing states like yours.
sentences.zh: 所以最后一个问题，拜登在许多民调中落后，而且在像你这样摇摆州，选情无疑非常胶着。

sentences.en: He is losing ground to young people, Black and brown voters.
sentences.zh: 他在年轻人、黑人和棕色人种选民中的支持率正在下降。

sentences.en: As we record this, the polls are pretty tight in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 在我们录制节目时，密歇根州的民调非常接近。

sentences.en: It's a must-win state.
sentences.zh: 这是一个不容有失的州。

sentences.en: Do you feel pressure to deliver the state?
sentences.zh: 你是否感到要在该州拿下选票的压力？

sentences.en: Can you?
sentences.zh: 你能做到吗？

sentences.en: Well, in 2022, we absolutely ran up our numbers and won by 11 points and flipped the legislature in the process.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在2022年，我们的得票数绝对大幅飙升，以11个百分点的优势获胜，并在此过程中顺势扭转了州议会的多数党地位。

sentences.en: We showed up everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我们在各个地方都全力以赴。

sentences.en: That is going to be even more important now than ever.
sentences.zh: 现在，这一点将比以往任何时候都更加重要。

sentences.en: I do always know that there's a path to victory through Michigan.
sentences.zh: 我一直都知道通过密歇根州有一条通往胜利的道路。

sentences.en: It's going to be a little more challenging this cycle, but we've rolled up our sleeves.
sentences.zh: 这个周期会更具挑战性，但我们已经卷起袖子大干一场了。

sentences.en: We're not going to get distracted if we don't celebrate small leads in polls.
sentences.zh: 如果民调中出现微弱领先，我们不会被冲昏头脑。

sentences.en: We don't, you know, fall apart when there's a small lead on the other side in a poll.
sentences.zh: 当民调中对方出现微弱领先时，我们也不会崩溃。

sentences.en: It's Michigan.
sentences.zh: 这里是密歇根。

sentences.en: It's going to be tight all the way through the election.
sentences.zh: 直到选举结束，选情都将异常胶着。

sentences.en: We're going to do the work, and I feel confident we're going to be able to win this race.
sentences.zh: 我们会做好工作，我有信心我们能够赢得这场竞选。

sentences.en: Gretchen Whitmer, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 格雷琴·惠特默，非常感谢。

sentences.en: I look forward to our next conversation.
sentences.zh: 我期待我们的下一次对话。

sentences.en: Me too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: After the break, I call the governor back to get her take on a few specific issues, including reproductive rights.
sentences.zh: 休息过后，我将再次致电州长，听取她对一些具体问题的看法，包括生殖权利。

sentences.en: Every American woman and her family and health care providers deserve to know that this fundamental question around health care is vested solely in the individual.
sentences.zh: 每一位美国女性、她的家人以及医疗服务提供者都理应知道，围绕医疗保健这一根本问题完全由个人自主决定。

sentences.en: And that's going to have to happen at the federal level.
sentences.zh: 而这必须在联邦层面实现。

sentences.en: So I do believe we've got to continue.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实认为我们必须继续努力。

sentences.en: And I do believe that's why this upcoming election has such high stakes.
sentences.zh: 我也坚信，这就是为什么即将到来的这场选举赌注如此之高。

sentences.en: I'm Winnaloo.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露（Winnaloo）。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏中的益智游戏“同义联系”（Connections），我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，我也喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖尔斯基（Sam Mazursky），我每天都制作“拼写蜜蜂”（Spelling Bee）和“字母盒”（Letterboxd）游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉（promesthesia）的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚刚听到声音的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: Hi, Governor Whitmer.
sentences.zh: 嗨，惠特默州长。

sentences.en: It's Lulu.
sentences.zh: 我是露露。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Where are you right now?
sentences.zh: 你现在在哪里？

sentences.en: Where am I catching you?
sentences.zh: 我是在哪里联系到你的？

sentences.en: Right now I am in Detroit.
sentences.zh: 我现在在底特律。

sentences.en: The great city of Detroit.
sentences.zh: 伟大的底特律市。

sentences.en: Governor, we only have a little bit of time, so I want to jump right in.
sentences.zh: 州长，我们的时间有限，所以我想直接切入正题。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: So I'm guessing that you're not going to tell me if you're running for president in 2028, right?
sentences.zh: 所以我猜你不会告诉我你是否会竞选2028年总统，对吧？

sentences.en: I don't know what the heck I'm going to do in 2028.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我在2028年到底要干什么。

sentences.en: So you can ask, but that's the honest answer.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以问，但这就是实话。

sentences.en: That's fair.
sentences.zh: 这很公平。

sentences.en: But you're clearly preparing for a bigger role on the national stage.
sentences.zh: 但你显然在为国家舞台上更重要的角色做准备。

sentences.en: You are term limited.
sentences.zh: 你的任期有限制。

sentences.en: Your term ends in 2026.
sentences.zh: 你的任期将于2026年结束。

sentences.en: So I do want to sort of understand how you think about some key issues.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实想了解一下你是如何看待一些关键问题的。

sentences.en: And after our last conversation, I was thinking about how we really didn't get to dig into reproductive rights.
sentences.zh: 在我们上次对话之后，我一直在想，我们其实并没有深入探讨生殖权利问题。

sentences.en: And I wanted to ask you, on a national level, Roe isn't coming back.
sentences.zh: 我想问你，在国家层面，罗伊案的判决已经无法挽回了。

sentences.en: You know, Congress has been unable to pass legislation protecting contraception, much less abortion.
sentences.zh: 你知道，国会一直未能通过保护避孕措施的立法，更不用说堕胎权了。

sentences.en: Do you see any way to protect abortion at the national level?
sentences.zh: 你觉得在国家层面还有什么办法能保护堕胎权吗？

sentences.en: Well, I do.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得有。

sentences.en: And I think ultimately that's got to be the goal right now.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这归根结底必须是当下的目标。

sentences.en: You know, we've seen it all across the country.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们在全国各地都看到了这一点。

sentences.en: When people get an opportunity to weigh in, they overwhelmingly, you know, vote to enshrine abortion rights.
sentences.zh: 当人们有机会表达意见时，你知道，他们绝大多数都会投票将堕胎权写入宪法。

sentences.en: We saw it in Ohio.
sentences.zh: 我们在俄亥俄州看到了。

sentences.en: We saw it in Wisconsin with their Supreme Court election.
sentences.zh: 我们在威斯康星州他们的最高法院选举中看到了。

sentences.en: We saw it in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 我们在密歇根州看到了。

sentences.en: A 10-year quest to undo legislation that made it more difficult for women to access abortion and health care.
sentences.zh: 历经十年的争取，终于废除了那些让女性更难获取堕胎和医疗服务的法律。

sentences.en: I got to sign the repeal of that into law in the wake of us amending our Constitution to protect abortion rights.
sentences.zh: 在我们修改宪法以保护堕胎权之后，我得以将废除该法律的法案签署生效。

sentences.en: And talk about that in the book, how personally gutted I was when I shared my story of being a sexual assault survivor.
sentences.zh: 我在书中也谈到了这一点，当我分享自己作为性侵幸存者的故事时，我内心是多么痛苦。

sentences.en: Didn't make a damn difference on the debate.
sentences.zh: 对这场辩论一点用都没有。

sentences.en: But 10 years later, as governor, we flipped the legislature.
sentences.zh: 但十年后，作为州长，我们翻盘了州议会。

sentences.en: We stayed at it.
sentences.zh: 我们坚持了下来。

sentences.en: And ultimately, I got to sign the repeal.
sentences.zh: 最终，我得以签署废除令。

sentences.en: Now, these are overarching issues.
sentences.zh: 现在，这些都是全局性的问题。

sentences.en: We don't solve them overnight, but the fight is worth having.
sentences.zh: 我们无法在一夜之间解决它们，但这场斗争是值得的。

sentences.en: What I'm hearing you say is that the only way to really resolve this now is going state by state.
sentences.zh: 我听到你的意思是，现在真正解决问题的唯一途径只能是一个州一个州地来。

sentences.en: And as you know, that's going to lead to basically a patchwork situation where some women will be able to have the right to reproductive freedom.
sentences.zh: 而且如你所知，这基本上会导致一种拼凑的局面，一些女性能够拥有生殖自由的权利。

sentences.en: And some women won't because of where they live.
sentences.zh: 而另一些女性则因为她们居住的地方而无法拥有。

sentences.en: Which is why, you know, at this point, this is where we can make progress in this moment by enshrining it where we have those tools.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么，你知道，在这一点上，我们可以在此时此地取得进展，通过在我们拥有这些工具的地方将其写入宪法。

sentences.en: But at the end of the day,
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，

sentences.en: every American woman and her family and health care providers deserve to know that this fundamental question around health care is vested solely in the individual.
sentences.zh: 每一位美国女性、她的家庭以及医疗保健提供者都理应知道，围绕医疗保健的这个根本问题完全掌握在个人手中。

sentences.en: And that's going to have to happen at the federal level.
sentences.zh: 而这必须在联邦层面实现。

sentences.en: So I do believe that's why this upcoming election has such high stakes, not just for abortion rights,
sentences.zh: 所以我确实相信，这就是为什么即将到来的这场选举利害攸关，不仅仅是为了堕胎权，

sentences.en: but certainly abortion rights are at the heart of a lot of what we're talking about, individual freedoMs.
sentences.zh: 当然，堕胎权是我们所讨论的很多关于个人自由的核心内容。

sentences.en: Speaking of that, you know, the Supreme Court has been mired in controversy, especially around Justices Alito and Thomas.
sentences.zh: 说起这个，你知道，最高法院一直陷入争议之中，特别是围绕阿利托和托马斯大法官。

sentences.en: Do you think they need to recuse themselves from rulings on anything to do with the 2020 election and President Trump?
sentences.zh: 你认为他们需要回避任何与2020年大选和特朗普总统相关的裁决吗？

sentences.en: Well, you know, as a lawyer, my understanding is that, you know, that would be appropriate.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，作为一名律师，我的理解是，你知道，那样做是合适的。

sentences.en: The Supreme Court operates under their own rules.
sentences.zh: 最高法院依据他们自己的规则运作。

sentences.en: I think it's really something that that gives me great anxiety is this distrust in institutions that have sustained this democracy for so long.
sentences.zh: 我认为真正让我感到焦虑的是这种对维持这个民主体制如此之久的机构的不信任。

sentences.en: And we sadly have seen so many Americans get persuaded by, I think, false information and undermine our institutions.
sentences.zh: 而我们可悲地看到，许多美国人被我认为是虚假的信息所说服，并破坏了我们的机构。

sentences.en: And then when you see justices that appear to have the real conflict, not recuse themselves, that further erodes our confidence in these institutions that sustain us democracy.
sentences.zh: 然后当你看到那些似乎有真正利益冲突的大法官不愿回避时，这进一步侵蚀了我们对维持我们民主的这些机构的信心。

sentences.en: And it's very concerning.
sentences.zh: 这非常令人担忧。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Do you think the court needs to be expanded then?
sentences.zh: 那么你认为有必要扩大最高法院的规模吗？

sentences.en: I mean, because it's a 6-3 majority.
sentences.zh: 我是说，因为现在是6比3的保守派多数。

sentences.en: And if things like abortion rights, for example, are ever going to be reconsidered, the current makeup of the court isn't one that is favorable to Democrats.
sentences.zh: 如果诸如堕胎权之类的事情有朝一日被重新审视，法院目前的组成对民主党人并不有利。

sentences.en: You know, Lulu, I get we're we're stepping way outside of, you know, my expertise is as a legal as a legal mind.
sentences.zh: 你知道，露露，我明白我们已经大大超出了，你知道，我的专业领域是作为一个法律界人士的范畴。

sentences.en: But I would just say this, whether or not the court gets expanded or whether or not, you know,
sentences.zh: 但我只想说，不管法院是否扩编，或者不管，你知道，

sentences.en: we just ensure that President Biden is the one in that office who makes the next handful of appointments.
sentences.zh: 我们只是确保拜登总统是那个在办公室里做出接下来几次任命的人。

sentences.en: All of these things work toward the same end of restoring some integrity into our government, which is desperately needed.
sentences.zh: 所有这些事情都朝着同一个目标努力，即恢复我们政府的一些诚信，而这是迫切需要的。

sentences.en: Moving to another subject, it does seem that 2028 is going to necessarily see a changing of the guard.
sentences.zh: 转到另一个话题，2028年似乎势必会迎来权力交接。

sentences.en: What do you hope your generation of politicians can do for the country?
sentences.zh: 你希望你这一代的政治家能为这个国家做些什么？

sentences.en: So I'm 52, almost 53.
sentences.zh: 所以我是52岁，快53岁了。

sentences.en: And, you know, as I talk to my fellow Gen Xers, best generation, yeah, we recognize that, you know, our our parents generation is we had a lot of excess.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，当我与同龄的X世代交谈时——最棒的一代，是的——我们认识到，你知道，我们父母那一代人，我们有过很多过度消费。

sentences.en: And certainly I worry about so many of the decisions that were made prior to my kids generation and what they are worried about.
sentences.zh: 当然，我担心在我的孩子这一代之前做出的那么多决定，以及他们在担心什么。

sentences.en: And so I'm hopeful that we can really move the needle,
sentences.zh: 所以我希望我们能够真正取得突破，

sentences.en: whether it's around bringing down our nation's debt or ensuring that we are active when it comes to climate and solidifying and protecting individual rights.
sentences.zh: 无论是降低国家的债务，还是确保我们在气候问题上采取积极行动，并巩固和保护个人权利。

sentences.en: These are really the existential issues that my kids generation is worried about, gun violence, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 这些确实是我的孩子这一代所担忧的生存危机，枪支暴力等等。

sentences.en: And so I'm hopeful that in 2028, we see a Gen Xers running for the White House and that someone from my generation is ready to take the mantle.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望在2028年，我们能看到X世代的人竞选白宫，并且我这一代人中有人准备好接过衣钵。

sentences.en: My last question is about Trump.
sentences.zh: 我的最后一个问题关于特朗普。

sentences.en: You know, he is a convicted felon now.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他现在是一名被定罪的重罪犯。

sentences.en: And even if he doesn't win the election, Trumpism as a political movement seems like it's here to stay.
sentences.zh: 而且即使他没有赢得大选，作为一场政治运动的特朗普主义似乎也会继续存在下去。

sentences.en: Do you agree with that?
sentences.zh: 你同意这种看法吗？

sentences.en: Do you think his ideas and his vision will outlast him?
sentences.zh: 你认为他的理念和愿景会比他更持久吗？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I'm not sure, to be honest, Lulu.
sentences.zh: 说实话，露露，我不太确定。

sentences.en: I think that there are still a lot of Republicans out there who would not identify as Trump supporters, but are not willing to relinquish their party.
sentences.zh: 我认为外面仍然有很多共和党人，他们不会将自己归为特朗普支持者，但也不愿意放弃他们的党派。

sentences.en: They're fighting to bring back some common sense and more traditional viewpoints and values to the party.
sentences.zh: 他们正在为把一些常识和更传统的观点与价值观带回党内而战。

sentences.en: And I'm hopeful that they're successful because I do think it's important for our system of governance to have robust debates with people with different perspectives.
sentences.zh: 我希望他们能成功，因为我确实认为，对于我们的治理体系来说，与持不同观点的人进行强有力的辩论是很重要的。

sentences.en: I miss having pro-choice Republicans in Michigan in government.
sentences.zh: 我很怀念密歇根州政府里有支持堕胎权的共和党人的日子。

sentences.en: I miss being able to have, you know, thoughtful debates and then ultimately find common ground.
sentences.zh: 我很怀念能够进行，你知道，深思熟虑的辩论，然后最终找到共同点的日子。

sentences.en: I'm always striving for it, but it's a lot more challenging.
sentences.zh: 我一直在为此努力，但这要具有挑战得多。

sentences.en: And, you know, I think the average person in this country expects that of us.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我认为这个国家的普通人对我们也有这样的期望。

sentences.en: And so I'm hopeful that this is a chapter, but not a trajectory.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望这只是一个篇章，而不是一条发展轨迹。

sentences.en: Governor Whitmer, thank you so much for your time.
sentences.zh: 惠特默州长，非常感谢你接受采访。

sentences.en: I really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我真的非常感激。

sentences.en: Thanks, Lulu.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，露露。

sentences.en: That's Governor Gretchen Whitmer.
sentences.zh: 那是密歇根州州长格雷琴·惠特默。

sentences.en: I remember, uh, I was 19.
sentences.zh: 我记得，呃，我当时19岁。

sentences.en: I went to the blues bar.
sentences.zh: 我去了蓝调酒吧。

sentences.en: It was me, Belushi, and Robin WilliaMs.
sentences.zh: 当时有我、贝鲁希和罗宾·威廉姆斯。

sentences.en: They took a Coke out, started doing Coke.
sentences.zh: 他们拿出了可卡因，开始吸食可卡因。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh no, I'm cool.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，哦不，我不用。

sentences.en: And, uh, every now and then I would, over the years, I would trip about that moment.
sentences.zh: 而且，呃，多年来我时不时会想起那个时刻。

sentences.en: Because I was really young and it would have been so easy to try some Coke.
sentences.zh: 因为我当时真的很年轻，而且要尝试一点可卡因是轻而易举的事。

sentences.en: I wasn't taking some moral stance.
sentences.zh: 我并不是在摆什么道德姿态。

sentences.en: If I just wasn't interested in it and to not have the desire or the curiosity of it, I'd say that's Providence.
sentences.zh: 我只是对它不感兴趣，而且也没有那种渴望或好奇心，我觉得这就是天意。

sentences.en: I'm Lulu Garcia Navarro, and this is The Interview from The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是露露·加西亚-纳瓦罗，这里是《纽约时报》的《访谈》。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了群自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就陷入了一场残酷、混乱且有时令人兴奋的争斗之中。
